title: Gate Zephyr SDK tarball downloads with checksums in CI workflows
description: Review finding (wkya round, converged from two passes): .github/workflows/renode.yml:130 and renode-firmware.yml:39 download Zephyr SDK tarballs with no hash verification — same defect class as the Renode download fixed in wkya (one-line 'echo <sha256>  <file> | sha256sum -c -' after wget, hash computed from the actual upstream artifact). Pre-existing, out of wkya's Renode scope; tracked so it is not lost.
close_reason: Hash-gated both Zephyr SDK downloads: .github/workflows/renode.yml:131 and renode-firmware.yml:40 now run 'echo c323afcd...  zephyr-sdk-0.16.8_linux-x86_64_minimal.tar.xz | sha256sum -c -' between wget and tar. Hash double-sourced: computed from the downloaded artifact AND matches upstream sdk-ng v0.16.8 published sha256.sum (two independent oracles agree); gate command executed live against the real artifact (OK). 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (format, fail-stop under bash -eo pipefail incl. truncated wget, placement correct for both extraction styles, YAML safe), security PASS (no cache on these steps to poison, strict improvement, no TOCTOU of consequence), edge-cases PASS with full enumeration: every wget/curl in both workflow files is now checksum-gated (6/6); remaining fetches are actions/*, apt signed repos, or uv sync --locked. No new findings — converged clean.
